options.title: Christmas at the Movies
options.source: Joe's sermon series email (Nov 17), Weekly Guide (invite cards from Nov 29)
options.why: Series launch day and invite cards hit the lobby today. Best invite window of the year.
bullets: Christmas movies you already love, with a twist.
Four Sundays: Polar Express, The Santa Clause, The Family Man, The Best Christmas Pageant Ever.
Each one points to something real. Hope. Purpose. What matters most.
Know someone who'd never come to church but loves these movies? This is the invite.
Grab a few invite cards in the lobby and hand one out this week.
flags: Joe's doc says "The Greatest Christmas Pageant Ever." The movie is "The Best Christmas Pageant Ever." I used the real title.

options.title: Turn the Tide Christmas gifts
options.when: Tags out Nov 29 and Dec 6, gifts back by Sunday, December 13
options.why: Tags go out this Sunday. Knox County impact, whole church can do it.
bullets: Some kids in our town won't get anything on their list this year. You can change that.
Grab a gift tag today. Every tag is a real kid's real wish.
Shop it, bring it back by December 13.
That's it. One tag, one kid, one Christmas morning.
flags: Where are the tags (Connection Center)? I left the location out.
The newsletter also mentions grocery bags for local students. I left that out to keep it to one ask. Add it if you want.

options.title: Christmas Experience
options.source: Church newsletter, Planning Center calendar, Weekly Guide, Christmas Experience slide
options.why: Church-wide family event two weeks out. Good time to get it on calendars.
bullets: Need one night this December that isn't shopping or wrapping?
Christmas Experience. Sunday, December 13, 6 PM, Family Life Center.
Music, treats, hot drinks, the whole family in one room.
Invite the neighbors. Easiest yes they'll give you all month.
flags: The newsletter also asks for cookie bakers (3 dozen, drop off Dec 11 or 13). Could be its own ask on Dec 6.

options.title: Next Step U: SHAPEd for Ministry
options.why: Sign-up class two weeks out. Could also wait a week and run Dec 6.
bullets: Ever wonder what God actually wired you for?
SHAPEd for Ministry helps you find it. Your gifts, passions, personality, story.
One short class, right after service on December 13.
Sign up on the Next Steps form. QR code's right in front of you.
